10 REM! INTEGER K
20 DIM D$(11,3)
30 XY=Z+INT(XY%):AB=XY%+5
40 IF (K-Z) THEN K=A:Y=NOT VAL(D$(XY%,AB%))
50 D$(Y*P%(XY%,K)+((P%(10,AB%)<=AB%))>=10,B%)=CHR$(A):SPEED=((P%(M%,K)<32767))/Y^XY+XY:PRINT
60 D$(AB%,LEN(CHR$(VAL(Q1$))))=RIGHT$(Y$,EXP(A=A))
70 M%=1:HCOLOR=AB%-((SIN(K)+SQR(Y)))
80 RESUME
90 AB=804:IF (A-XY>NOT 256-((B%+P%(M%,XY%)))) THEN AB%=XY%
100 PRINT M% OR A,
110 DATA 1,"A,B",300,X:GET B%:PRINT A,-((M%*0))*P%(127,10);
120 IF (-((Z/127=((491>1000))))) THEN K=P%(TAN(VAL(Y$)),B%)
130 K=.5
140 COLOR=VAL(STR$(M%*20)):GOTO 10:PRINT Y<=P%(PEEK(39),-Z);"TASC"+RIGHT$("",24/AB%),
150 IF (AB%<P%(B%,P%(K,AB%)/39)) THEN Y$=LEFT$(A$(3),XY%<=539)+Q1$:FOR Y=(P%(ATN(1),XY%>Z)-((XY+P%(M%,M%)>=-24734))) TO (Z<=A>=Y=M%)
160 READ K,M%:INVERSE:PRINT Y;Y$;
170 A=Z OR -AB%+((M%<Y)):DATA 1,300,HI,-2.5:PRINT (AB%);
180 XY=473-B%+40-40
190 HPLOT 1.5*-(P%(40,49152)),(859*P%(LEN(Y$),SGN(5))):GOSUB 110
